> Hi! Have a look at my forecasts prepared to answer the RBA cash rate survey by [finder.com.au](https://www.finder.com.au/rba-cash-rate).

## Survey answers

Based on the forecasts above, and the analysis of forecasts from individual models, I formed the following survey answers:

**When you think the RBA will change the cash rate?**

|   | Nov 2026 | Dec 2026 | Feb 2027 | Mar 2027 | Apr 2027 | May 2027 | July 2027 | Aug 2027 | Sep 2027 or beyond |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Increase | ✓ |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Hold |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Decrease |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

**Why do you think this?**

>   We seem to be up for another one! My forecasting system indicates an 88 percent probability of a RAISE in the cash rate. Most of my models say so, delivering exceptionally high chances of such an outcome. A rate hike seems in line with increasing inflation and the RBA’s communication for such an occassion. My forecasts are available at: https://forecasting-cash-rate.github.io/
